fixes: 塔罗模式现已重新启用旧版存储与界面权限，恢复了在较旧版本主程序中的正常运行与数据保存支持。
Tarot Mode now reinstates legacy storage and interface permissions, restoring normal operation and data saving on older versions of the host application.

releases.body:
## English

### Fixes

- Tarot Mode now reinstates legacy storage and interface permissions, restoring normal operation and data saving on older versions of the host application.

---

## 中文

### 修复

- 塔罗模式现已重新启用旧版存储与界面权限，恢复了在较旧版本主程序中的正常运行与数据保存支持。

improvements: 塔罗模式现在请求的权限更少，移除了豁免的存储权限和界面访问权限。
Tarot Mode now requests fewer permissions, removing its exempt storage and UI access permissions.

releases.body:
